provenance.condition_delta_vs_v30: the v3.0 campaign (covtl-lambda v1.2.0 verbatim, C1 selector only) is preserved under work/legacy_lipblocked/; under v3.1 the jaw/tongue rotation is bitwise identical to v3.0 and only the C2-only lip columns inside the C1-incident sub-arcs differ (NV frames: bitwise no-op, all lambda)
provenance.probe: nasal-place logistic probe on window means, training base = the original 36-sentence base (LOSO curves identical to the stage-1 report; instrument unchanged across kit versions)

provenance.dotted_reference: the 'original' block reuses the v2.1 dotted-endpoint probings (klin.pan / klim.pan tier); verified equal to the stage-1 classification to 1.4e-4 (float32 round-trip)
